szenen.text: Altcoins just lost their most important line. This is TOTAL3, the market cap of all crypto except Bitcoin and Ether.
It dropped to 653 billion dollars, below its 200 week moving average near 680 billion. That line held for the whole cycle.
The next key support sits around 540 billion, that's 17% lower.
The 200 week average marked the floor of past bear markets. A weekly close below it would be a strong bearish signal. Weekly close is tonight at midnight UTC. Follow for the close.
